name: Vestige -Yaiba ni Nokoru wa Kimi no Omokage-
source:
Kurou was reading a book in the library when he saw his older sister Shizu fall from the roof. Fortunately, she wasn’t hurt badly. Kuro and their osananajimi Ruri are happy that she’s fine and don’t ask her what happened. Later, he finds out from his classmate Wakaba that she was fighting against some mysterious men. It is because they are after him, as he possesses the elixir of immortality ‘ochimizu’, so he decides to take part in the battle as well.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
九郎正在图书馆看书时，目睹姐姐静从屋顶坠落。幸运的是，她伤得并不严重。九郎与青梅竹马琉璃都为她平安无事感到高兴，也没有追问究竟发生了什么。后来，他从同学若叶口中得知，静当时正在与一群神秘男子战斗。那些人的目标正是九郎，因为他体内拥有长生不老的灵药“变若水”。于是，九郎也决定投身战斗。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
